title: Monsters, version 1
description: A file under content/monsters/ (work order 005, scope 1). Holds a list of monsters under 'monsters'. Each monster has an id of the form monster.<zone>.<name>, zone one of rustmoor, cinderworks, thunderhead, global (the same list as items and actions); a name; one line of flavour of at most 20 words; level, an integer 1 to 100, the main combat level at which the monster becomes the player's sensible target; boss, a boolean; weakness, one of melee, marksmanship, aetherics (GDD section 6: 'Monsters are weak to Melee, Marksmanship, or Aetherics'); xp, the positive total combat XP for one kill before the main-skill split; and seconds_per_kill, the positive TARGET time for one kill by a player at 'level', including the time between kills: a design target the later combat-stats work order must hit, not a result of stats. No hit points, damage or drops yet. 'revision' (file or monster) is optional and exists only so a register row's revision can match what it points at, as for items and actions. maxWords is a keyword this repo's validator adds: whitespace-separated words.
